purpose: Defend novelty of CD associator as multichannel time-series diagnostic

searches.query: non-associative algebra signal processing time series

nearest.title: Hypercomplex Phase Retrieval
nearest.relevance: Uses quaternion/octonion for imaging phase retrieval. Adjacent but does NOT use non-associativity or associator norms. Stays within Clifford algebra framework. Operates on images, not time series.

nearest.title: Octonion Phase Retrieval
nearest.relevance: Octonion Wirtinger flow for 8-band imaging. Does not exploit non-associativity as a diagnostic.

nearest.title: Octonionic Geometry
nearest.relevance: Discusses non-associativity conceptually in gravity. Does NOT quantify associator as a measurable physical observable.

nearest.title: Division Algebras and Quantum Theory (Baez)
nearest.relevance: Restricts to associative algebras (R, C, H). Explicitly excludes octonions. No associator as observable.

adjacent_literatures.status: Well-established (Ell, Le Bihan, Sangwine). Restricted to 4D associative algebras. Does not venture into non-associative territory.
adjacent_literatures.gap: No use of non-associativity as a signal diagnostic

adjacent_literatures.status: Classical (Takens 1981, Sauer et al. 1991). Always embeds into Euclidean R^n.
adjacent_literatures.gap: Never embeds into hypercomplex algebras. No algebraic structure exploited.

adjacent_literatures.status: Persistent homology for shape detection. Conceptually similar boundary detection.
adjacent_literatures.gap: Different mathematical framework. No connection to CD algebras.

adjacent_literatures.status: Recurrence plots, Lyapunov exponents, fractal dimensions.
adjacent_literatures.gap: Uses scalar invariants of the embedding, not algebraic structure of the target space.

adjacent_literatures.status: Octonions in string theory, M-theory, exceptional groups (Baez, Duff).
adjacent_literatures.gap: Treats non-associativity as a theoretical framework property, not as a quantitative observable on data.

novelty_statement: To our knowledge, no prior work uses Cayley-Dickson associator observables as multichannel time-series diagnostics for physical field data. Adjacent literatures exist in quaternion/Clifford signal processing, Takens embeddings, and conceptual non-associative physics, but they do not appear to operationalize non-associativity as a quantitative cross-channel phase-geometry probe.
